definition: Valence shell electron pair repulsion: the electron domains around a central atom repel each other and spread as far apart as possible, which sets the shape of the molecule.
A region of electron density around a central atom: a lone pair, or the bond to one other atom, where a single, double or triple bond each count as one domain.
The arrangement in space of all the electron domains around a central atom, lone pairs included: linear, trigonal planar or tetrahedral for two, three or four domains.
The arrangement in space of the atoms around a central atom; lone pairs affect it but are not named in it, and it matches the electron domain geometry only when the central atom has no lone pairs.
